parameters.content:
Required env vars (SSoT):
- GITLAB_API_BASE_URL (or GITLAB_BASE_URL)
- GITLAB_TOKEN (or N8N_GITLAB_TOKEN)
- Optional: GITLAB_GROUP_FULL_PATH

Default target:
- project_ref: ${GITLAB_GROUP_FULL_PATH}/general-management (fallback: ${N8N_REALM}/general-management)
- labels: ITSM/継続的改善 AND 状態/Approved

Webhook:
- POST /webhook/itsm/cir/usecases/approved/list
Body (optional):
- gitlab_project_id | gitlab_project_path
- cir_label (default: ITSM/継続的改善)
- approved_label (default: 状態/Approved)
- issue_state (default: opened)
- dry_run (true/false)
